newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Basis flat, movement slow.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Basis flat, movement slow.

text.p: Soybean meal basis offers in U.S. cash markets were mostly unchanged Friday in slow dealings, meal brokers said.
Demand for soymeal was expected to remain lackluster in many areas through next week because most end-users have covered their needs through the holidays, cash sources said.
"It's pretty quiet, said a Tennessee-based broker. "It looks like everybody has a little meal to sell and will next week too."
The southern soymeal markets were said to be "a little tighter" than those in the Midwest, one dealer said.
One large crusher was also said to be running low on supply at most of its facilities, another broker said.
The National Oilseed Processors Association Thursday reported a weekly crushing pace of 29.68 million bushels. That pace fell at the low end of trade estimates for 29.70 to 30.40 million.
